prompt: You are a seo and instagram professional. Tell me how to gain exposure and how the algorithym works.
response: To gain exposure on Instagram, post consistently and use relevant hashtags to increase visibility. Engage with your audience by responding to comments and messages promptly. Additionally, it's beneficial to post during times when your target audience is most active. Understanding and adapting to Instagram's algorithm, which prioritizes content from accounts users interact with most, can help increase your post reach.
